environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed via EKS-hosted container (Lambda Web Adapter pattern on Kubernetes). Pod runs in namespace 'ws-prod' with label app=ws-handler. Cluster has a default-deny egress NetworkPolicy applied at namespace level (metadata: {name: restrict-metadata-egress, namespace: ws-prod}, spec: {podSelector: {matchLabels: {app: ws-handler}}, policyTypes: [Egress], egress: [{to: [{ipBlock: {cidr: '0.0.0.0/0', except: ['169.254.169.254/32']}}], ports: [{protocol: TCP, port: 443}, {protocol: TCP, port: 80}]}, {to: [{namespaceSelector: {matchLabels: {name: kube-system}}}], ports: [{protocol: UDP, port: 53}]}]}). Additionally, the pod's service account has an IRSA annotation (eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn) bound to a role with a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/NoDynamoDBWriteNoSecretsRead) that explicitly denies dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:DeleteItem, and secretsmanager:GetSecretValue. The API Gateway WebSocket route still has no authorizer configured.
